summary: The global marketing team is executing a focused SEO/AI-search visibility push for Asia Star and Intelligent China while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and resolving a lingering Outlook account lockout.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the SEO/AI-search visibility initiative, with Joseph tasked to draft target areas/prompts, profile Asia Star participants and CRM hot leads, and obtain a conversion tracking brief; the Intelligent China webpage launch and prioritization in the audit are also urgent. The knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: Joseph must share the HTML design file, the team needs a 30-minute feedback session, and Joker will implement changes based on the agreed look and feel with menu improvements and video dispersion. This week, the team must resolve the Outlook account lockout by re-logging in on all devices and confirming with JSB that the backend lock is lifted. Looking ahead, Joseph has a November 18 deadline for multiple deliverables including LinkedIn message text for Asia Start video participants, spotlight video distribution, a news article on Dean Xiang's role, newsletter prominence for the Women in Leadership Forum, feedback on the ESG and Social Innovation webpage, video promotion screenshots, and follow-up questions for Manaferra; the team must also ensure updated agendas and posters for Professor Xiaomeng's speech are used in promotion.

decisions.text: Re-login with new passwords across all devices to resolve the account lockout.
Remove the standalone video section; disperse videos by topic instead
Keep the current knowledge site look and feel rather than a dramatic revamp
Adopt the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu)
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the knowledge section
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage
Asia Star and Intelligent China are the top two promotion priorities; US partner programs put on hold initially.
Berkeley program to be considered as a possible third priority and included in the audit phase.
Proceed with the new Manaferra brand prompts after feedback
